subtasks.name: stack(middle_black_bowl, back_black_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: failed: held bowl brought beside the back bowl (140-200), then drifts left and hovers holding it to the end; never placed on top

behaviour_summary: pi0 picks the correct middle bowl and brings it alongside the back bowl at about the same height, then holds it beside/left of the back bowl for the rest of the episode without lifting over and releasing onto it.

failures.mode_definition: pi0 carries the grasped object to the vicinity of the destination but stalls with a lateral offset beside or at the edge of it and never lowers and releases it onto the destination.
failures.rl_success_check: middle bowl resting inside/on the back bowl (LIBERO On), gripper open and lifted clear
failures.observation: Steps 80-100: gripper descends on the image-left (middle) bowl and lifts it. 140-200: held bowl side by side with the back bowl, at similar height (back bowl appears nudged slightly toward the front at ~100). 240: held bowl moved away to the left of the back bowl. 260-409: gripper with the bowl hovers left of/over the back bowl area; the stack is never made.

notes: From 260 on the gripper occludes the back bowl, so the exact offset at the end is not visible; there is no sign of a release. Grasp/transport: evidence_grasp_transport.png.
